heading: Convert to PDF
subheading: Turn any file into an editable PXA design, or convert a scanned image into a searchable PDF.

import.heading: Import a file
import.subheading: Choose the format, then select a file — it opens as an editable PXA design.

pdf.label: PDF
pdf.description: Text, shapes, and images extracted from any PDF file.

docx.label: Word DOCX
docx.description: Paragraphs, tables, and inline images from Word Open XML.

pptx.label: PowerPoint
pptx.description: Each slide becomes a PXA page with shapes, text, and images.

doc.label: Word DOC
doc.description: Legacy Word 97-2003 binary format — text extracted as editable elements.

odt.label: OpenDocument
odt.description: ODF text with paragraph styles, headings, and embedded images.

markdown.label: Markdown
markdown.description: Headings, lists, tables, and formatted text from a .md file.

svg.label: SVG
svg.description: Full vector fidelity — paths, groups, text, and embedded images.

image.label: Image
image.description: Raster image placed as a full-page PXA design.

image-analysis.label: Image (Smart)
image-analysis.description: Custom OCR engine — recognises text, shapes, and colours as individual editable elements.

config.assetBaseUriHint: Optional public HTTP(S) folder used to resolve relative Markdown images.

import.importFailed: Import failed. Please check the file and try again.

ocr.heading: Convert an image to PDF
ocr.subheading: Embedded Tesseract OCR turns a scanned or photographed page into a searchable PDF.
ocr.ocrLanguageHint: Hold ⌘/Ctrl to select several — they’re combined (e.g. German + English).
